sentences.text: This Misc.Appeal u/s 173 (1) of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant/claimant against impugned award dated 16.1.2023 passed in MVC No.921/2019 by 1st Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Katni seeking enhancement of Rs.2 lacs.

entities.text: 1st Additional Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Katni
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The facts of the case, in brief, are that on 11.9.2019 at about 11 hours the appellant was going on his motorcycle (MP-21/MM-2287) from home to Katni Court.

As soon as he reached Tilgawan Bus Stand offending vehicle (Bolero -MP21/TA-0877) coming from opposite direction which driven rashly by respondent no.1/Jitendra dashed against him as a result of which he sustained injuries over various parts of body.
and he was hospitalized and given treatment.
The appellant filed claim petition claiming compensation of Rs.12,50,000/-, however, the Tribunal awarded compensation of Rs.99,079/-.

3. Learned counsel for the appellant being dissatisfied with the impugned award filed this appeal on the grounds that Tribunal ought to have granted suitable compensation for medical expenses occurred in treatment, for mental pain & sufferings, special diet, attendant, future treatment.

The Tribunal ought to have seen that appellant suffered fracture and permanent disability to the extent of 15% but it erroneously observed that the same would not be affecting earning capacity of appellant.
It has also not awarded compensation for loss of income.
4. Learned counsel for the respondents have opposed the submissions and supported the impugned award of the Tribunal and claimed dismissal of instant appeal.
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the Tribunal as also the impugned award.

Considering the nature of injuries, period of hospitalization, expenses over treatment,
income of injured, amount 3 MA-2418-2023 awarded by the Tribunal in respect of treatment,
special diet, attendant and future treatment, this Court is of the considered opinion that in the interest of justice enhancement of lumpsum amount of Rs.1,00,00/- [Rupees One lac only] would be just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
6. With above enhancement of amount of compensation by Rs.1 lacs the appeal is partly allowed.
Other terms and conditions in the impugned award passed by Tribunal shall remain intact.

(AVANINDRA KUMAR SINGH) JUDGE RM Rajesh Mishra vs Jitendra Sharma on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/5856474/
